hints.title: Rightmost Non-Nine Node
hints.text: Adding one will cascade carry across trailing nines to the rightmost digit that is less than nine.

hints.title: Dummy Head and Sentinel Tracking
hints.text: Prepend a dummy node with value zero. Keep track of the rightmost node whose value is not nine.

hints.title: Single Pass Carry Propagation
hints.text: Scan the list from head to tail. Whenever a node value is not 9, update your sentinel pointer. After reaching the tail, increment the sentinel node value by one and set all subsequent node values to zero. Return the dummy if its value changed to 1, else return the original head.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.notes: Single forward pass with two pointers and constant extra space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Reversing the list or converting to huge integer types requires extra traversals or overflows integer limits.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Tracking the rightmost non-9 node in a single forward pass eliminates list reversal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Solve in a single forward pass without reversing the linked list in O(1) space.
